entities.summary: Sofia Shinas (b. 1968-01-17, Windsor) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Windsor and Canada. Known in the fields of canada, composers & musicians, americas.
